title: Demon Huntress Battle
description: A female warrior with long green hair and glowing spiral tattoos leaps mid-air in a ruined hall, dual-wielding glowing curved blades. She is surrounded by floating daggers, purple smoke, and a massive shadowy demon with red eyes and bat-like wings looming in a blood-red sky above.
prompt: A fierce female warrior with long flowing green hair and glowing golden spiral tattoos on her back and arms, wearing a green and red outfit, leaping dynamically through the air while dual-wielding two large glowing curved swords. She is surrounded by multiple floating enchanted daggers with glowing tips, swirling purple and blue magical smoke and energy. In the background, a gigantic terrifying shadowy demon with large bat wings, glowing red eyes and horns towers over a destroyed ancient hall filled with rubble, broken pillars, skulls and swords on the ground, dramatic red and black stormy sky, dark fantasy style, highly detailed, cinematic lighting
